rerun_policy: INSUFFICIENT_DATA (either arm under 5 scorable rows) is topped up, never replaced (Codex P1 on #276, comment 4171601821, superseding the full-replacement wording). Error rows are excluded from the verdict by the engine: A0 is a gradeError row; trial_killed_incomplete, trial_wrote_repo and provider_refusal are infraError rows (scripts/lib/eval-trial.js:271-310); scorableResults drops both (scripts/lib/eval-stats.js:83-85) and verdictFromDeltaCI returns INSUFFICIENT_DATA on fewer than 5 scorable rows per arm before any CI (scripts/lib/eval-stats.js:387-393). Top-up: run `arcforge eval ab <scenario> --k 1` with the same skill file and flags (one trial per arm, 2 sessions) and repeat until both arms hold >= 5 scorable rows, at most 2 top-ups (4 sessions) per scenario. No row is discarded: the verdict is `arcforge eval compare <scenario>`, which loads every row of the scenario Version (scripts/cli/eval-command.js:519-525) and pools rows sharing model, effort, ceiling and turn budget (pairArms, scripts/lib/eval-pools.js:139-148); preflight writes only its cache record, so its trials are not pooled. Each run's own eval ab summary (first run and every top-up) is recorded in the ledger beside the pooled verdict. eval ab has no arm or trial selector (runAbTrials, scripts/lib/eval.js:160-181), so a top-up adds a row to both arms and an arm that already held 5 can end with 6 or 7; IMPROVED is still the engine's delta CI on the pooled rows wholly above 0. Still under 5 in an arm after 2 top-ups -> INSUFFICIENT_DATA, unmeasured. trial_wrote_repo aborts its run (stopIfTrialWroteRepo, scripts/lib/eval-trial.js:341-348); rows written before it are on disk (appendResult per trial, scripts/lib/eval.js:140) and stay in the pool; after the repository is reset the top-up rule applies to them the same way. No full replacement run exists. A preflight that measured nothing because of grade or infrastructure errors is rerun once (3 sessions); a BLOCK is a finding: no A/B, no second preflight. Budget: scheduled 26 (sessions 3 + 10, router 3 + 10; verify-exit 0, design-gate.verify-exit.md) + top-ups at most 4 per scenario x 2 = 34, + the preflight error rerun 3 = 37 <= ~40; the 3 left are used for nothing.
